parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number in a paged query. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh_cn**.

Valid values:

- **zh_cn**: Simplified Chinese.
- **en_us**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: UsageScenario
parameters.description:
The scenario in which the API is called. Default value: **null**.

Valid values:
- **null**: legacy version.
- **0**: legacy version.
- **1**: new version.
